snippet.title: DineInn Trailer - Wishlist on Steam #dineinn #indiegame #gamedevelopment
snippet.description:
Greetings.
Dineinn is a cozy horror cooking game developed by a single dev.
If you like the trailer, please wish-list and play the free demo on steam.
